aiProviders.name: Name
aiProviders.baseUrlOptional: Base URL (optional — leave blank for the provider default)
aiProviders.apiKeyExisting: Leave empty to keep current key
aiProviders.modelHint: Optional. Falls back to the chat model when blank.
aiProviders.isDefault: Use as default for AI features
aiProviders.deleteConfirmBody: Your API key will be removed from our database. This cannot be undone.
aiProviders.keyEncryptedNotice: Your API key is encrypted at rest and only used to call AI for your account. We never display the full key after you save it.

hint.OPENAI: Get an API key from platform.openai.com. Keys start with sk-.
hint.NVIDIA: NVIDIA NIM / API Catalog keys start with nvapi-. Choose a model from the catalog.
hint.GEMINI: Create an API key in Google AI Studio. Pick a Gemini model (e.g. gemini-1.5-flash).
hint.ANTHROPIC: Get an API key from console.anthropic.com. Use a model id like claude-opus-4-7.
hint.OPENROUTER: OpenRouter routes to many models — keys start with sk-or-. The model id is provider/model.
hint.CUSTOM_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You must enter the base URL (e.g. https://my-llm.example.com/v1).

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: You control what we collect and what AI sees. Toggles take effect on the next request — no background sync.

personalizationEnabled.label: Personalise my experience
personalizationEnabled.hint: Master switch. When off, AI returns generic responses, the assistant stops using your profile/timezone, and the gates below have no effect.

useTasksForAI.label: Use tasks + deadlines for AI
useTasksForAI.hint: Sends task counts and statuses to AI for daily review and weekly insight.

useHabitsForAI.label: Use habits for AI
useHabitsForAI.hint: Sends recent habit log counts to AI for review and gentle nudges.

useMealsForAI.label: Use meals + dietary profile for AI
useMealsForAI.hint: Sends meal logs and dietary preferences to AI for meal suggestions.

useGoalsForAI.label: Use personal goals for AI
useGoalsForAI.hint: Sends goal progress so AI can suggest small daily actions.

useVoiceInput.label: Voice input
useVoiceInput.hint: Microphone is used only while you hold a record button. We never record in the background.

useScheduleForAI.label: Use schedule + tasks + habits for AI
useScheduleForAI.hint: Sends today's plan, tasks and habit progress to AI when generating your schedule, daily review or weekly insight.

useFinanceForAI.label: Use finance for AI
useFinanceForAI.hint: Sends income, expense and budget aggregates to AI for finance analysis. When off, AI finance analysis returns a generic template — your data stays in the app.

useHealthForAI.label: Use sleep / mood / health for AI
useHealthForAI.hint: Sends recent sleep duration, dominant mood, basic health metrics to AI for review and insights.

useMealForAI.label: Use meals + dietary profile for AI
useMealForAI.hint: Sends meal logs and dietary preferences to AI for meal suggestions.

useCalendarContext.label: Use phone calendar (read events you choose)
useCalendarContext.hint: We never read your calendar without an explicit per-event pick. The OS asks you each time.

useLocationContext.label: Use foreground location
useLocationContext.hint: Used only while the app is open, only to estimate travel time. We never request background location.

useHealthFitnessContext.label: Use phone Health / Fitness data
useHealthFitnessContext.hint: Sleep + steps + activity, when the OS exposes them. You authorise specific categories in Settings.

voiceInputEnabled.label: Enable voice input
voiceInputEnabled.hint: Microphone is used only while you hold a record button. We never record in the background.

proactiveRecommendations.label: Proactive recommendations
proactiveRecommendations.hint: Lets the assistant nudge you with rule-based recommendations from your own data. No AI calls when off.

anonymizedDiagnostics.label: Send anonymous diagnostics
anonymizedDiagnostics.hint: Crash + perf metrics with no PII. Off by default.

permissions.title: Permission Center
permissions.subtitle: These OS permissions are requested only when the matching feature is turned on.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.purpose: Reminders for tasks, schedule, sleep, meals, budget, goals and assistant nudges. Asked when you tap Enable in Settings or during onboarding.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.purpose: Read events you pick so AI can avoid clashes. Only requested when you turn on "Use phone calendar" in Privacy.

healthFitness.title: Health / Fitness
healthFitness.purpose: Read sleep, steps and activity if your phone exposes them. Lifestyle advice only — never a diagnosis.

location.title: Foreground location
location.purpose: Estimate travel time while the app is open. We never use background location.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.purpose: Voice notes while you hold record. The mic is OFF every other second.

camera.title: Camera & photos
camera.purpose: Avatar + receipt scanning. Asked only when you tap a feature that needs it.

permissions.noBackground: No background recording. No tracking. No reading other apps.

consent.title: How LifeOS learns about you
consent.intro: You control your data. Toggle anything on or off — anytime. AI only uses the data you allow to give you personal advice.
consent.promise: We do not listen in. We do not track your phone. We do not read other apps.

schedule.title: Schedule & tasks

habits.title: Habits

evidence.empty: No evidence recorded for this recommendation yet.

clearMemory.title: Clear AI memory
clearMemory.subtitle: AI keeps a small set of preferences and patterns to give you better advice. Clearing wipes them — past chat history is NOT deleted.
clearMemory.explainer:
• Patterns the AI noticed (eg. "prefers light dinners")
• Routines (eg. "usually walks after dinner")
• Long-term preferences

What's NOT cleared: your tasks, expenses, sleep logs, finance data, or chat messages. Use Export data + Delete account for those.
clearMemory.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. AI will rebuild memory from new interactions if you keep personalisation on.

actions.exportHint: Get a JSON copy of every row you own. May take a moment.
actions.deleteHint: Schedules permanent deletion of your account + every owned row in 30 days.
actions.deleteConfirmBody: Your account and every row tied to it will be permanently deleted in 30 days. You can cancel by signing back in within that window.

voiceModal.title: Voice input
voiceModal.body: When enabled, the microphone activates only while you hold a record button. We never listen in the background.

communication.title: Communication assistant
communication.subtitle: Email triage, follow-up reminders, AI memory. None of it runs without your explicit toggle.
communication.promise: We never read messages in other apps. We never listen in the background. We never auto-send anything.
